semantic_label: texture two uv region: bind the inverse extent pair plus a third scale term on texture slot two, borrowing the texture one raster

abi.frame: PUSH EBP / MOV EBP,ESP / SUB ESP,0x30
abi.return_contract: MOV AL,0x1 at 0x00518efa writes only the low lane, so the model returns the widened one

observed_body.instruction_count_source: the reviewed staging handoff for this address
instruction_list: read the scale through the port 0x006a2710 with the key 0x0c19db33 and the global scale source pointer
substitute the fallback 5.0 when the scale is exactly zero
read the painter through the system port 0x00401080 and take texture slot two
start the render and set the material to 0x9e74d163
read the raster from texture slot one + 0x60, raise the raster count when it is non-null and bind it at +0x3c
store the parameter quad with the inverse width, the inverse height, the scale divided by three and a zero fourth lane
paint the unit rectangle, end the render and answer one

runtime_gates: the receiver is never dereferenced; the target reads the scale source from a package global instead
all six ports are dependency-only, so the scale read is unverified in this package
the global scale source pointer has no resolved owner
the divide by three is a float divide and follows the default rounding mode
decompilation_defects_corrected: the decompilation treats any zero scale as the fallback; the assembly compares the float against zero and only then substitutes 5.0, so a negative scale is kept, and the corrected model keeps the exact zero test
the decompilation reads the raster from the receiver; the assembly reads it from texture slot one, so the model keeps the slot one source
